sentences.text: Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the High Court be pleased to suspend the sentence in SC No.35/2017 on the files of the Special Judge's Court (POCSO), Thrissur
. If the sentence is not so suspended, the petitioner would be put to irreparable injuries and hardships.
On the other hand, no prejudice will be caused to any of the respondent if the sentence is so suspended.

This Application coming on for orders upon perusing the application and upon hearing the arguments of M/S.SARATH BABU KOTTAKKAL, REBIN VINCENT GRALAN, Advocates for the petitioner and of PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the respondent, the court passed the following:
 P.T.O.
 C.S.SUDHA, J.
 --------------------------------------------------------------
 Crl.M.Appl. No.1 of 2022  in  Crl. Appeal No.907 of 2022  ---------------------------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 6th day of February 2025  ORDER
This application under Section 389 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking suspension of sentence of the applicant/accused in S.C.No.35 of 2017 on the file of the Special Judge's Court (PoCSO), Thrissur.

He has been found guilty of the offences punishable under Sections 6 read with 5(l) and (m) of the Xxxxxx vs State Of Kerala on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197841515/
1 PoCSO Act and Sections 342 and 376(2)(i) IPC.
He has been sentenced to varying terms of imprisonment for the aforesaid offences.
The sentences have been directed to run concurrently.
The maximum period of imprisonment he will have to undergo is 20 years.

2. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant/accused that there are several inconsistencies in the statements as well as in the testimony of PW2, the victim, as well in as PW1,
her mother who had given Ext.P1 FIS.
It is pointed out that the case of penetrative sexual assault is not supported by the medical evidence.
It is also pointed out that there is no consistent evidence relating to the date of the alleged incident.
In addition to the aforesaid aspects, it is also pointed out that the applicant/accused is a 75 year old man suffering from Hydrocele and Bradycardia and that he requires surgery.
Earlier, he was granted interim bail for a period of one month for the purpose of undergoing surgery.
However, as his blood pressure could not be brought under control, the surgery could not take place and hence on medical grounds also the suspension is sought for.

3. The learned public prosecutor opposes the application and submits that the victim child, who was only 10 years old, has clearly deposed before the court that she was unable to recall the date on which the incidents of abuse took place.
However, she has clearly deposed that on three different occasions, the accused herein had committed digital rape on her.
This probably must be in the reason why she was unable to recollect the exact dates on which the incident took place.

The learned public prosecutor also draws my attention to the testimony of PW4, a consultant pediatrician, Sun Hospital, Thrissur, to substantiate the argument that the medical evidence is also there to support the prosecution story.
4. Heard both sides.
5. I was taken through Ext.P1 FIS as well as the testimony of PW2, the victim; PW1, the mother and PW9, the doctor who examined the victim child on 24/11/2016.
Ext.P1 FIS is seen given by the mother on 24/11/2016.
In the FIS, the allegation is that the incident of abuse took place on 22/11/2016.

According to the testimony of PW1, the mother, the incident took place on 24/11/2016 and it was on the same day she had taken PW2 to the hospital as she had seen injuries on the private parts as well as a hair inside the mouth of PW2.
However PW9, the doctor who examined the child on 24/11/2016 in Ext.P6 medical in certificate records that there was no external injury.
As far as the testimony of PW4 is concerned, it is seen that there are absolutely no records to support his testimony that he had examined the child sometime in November 2016.

It is also brought to my notice that the victim child had stated in her 161 statement that the incident took place on 23/11/2016 whereas in her chief examination, her testimony was that the incident took place on 22/11/2016.
This contradiction was brought out in her examination and proved through the testimony of PW6 and the same has been marked as Ext.D2.

On going through the testimony of the material prosecution witnesses, I think that the learned counsel for the applicant/accused is justified in arguing that there are inconsistencies in the testimonies and that doubts arise from the materials on record.

It appears that the applicant/accused has got a good arguable case and therefore in the aforesaid circumstances and on medical ground, the sentence of the applicant/accused is in suspended till the disposal of the appeal.

It is submitted that the fine amount has already been deposited before the trial court.

Sd/-
